criteria.requirement: Boundary and chosen route are evidenced; observations match the activity card.
No avoidable fossil lock-in; material lifecycle effects assessed.
Lifetime hazard screen, material risk assessment and implemented adaptation; no harm to others.
Water permits, abstraction/discharge limits, required assessments and management measures.
National pollution and prohibited-substance requirements; activity-specific limits.
Waste hierarchy, resource efficiency, hazardous-waste traceability and end-of-life arrangements.
Required EIA, habitat screening and implemented mitigation.
Labour rights, minimum age, no child/forced labour, equality and worker representation.
Applicable occupational safety, hazard prevention and emergency readiness.
Proportionate human-rights diligence, stakeholder/social-impact process and grievance mechanism.
Durable, recyclable, dismantlable and refurbishable components assessed and used where feasible.
Implemented panel end-of-life management consistent with recycling standards.
If biomass / hydrogen used, cross-referenced taxonomy criteria met; waste nonrecyclable with separation and air standards.
If CCS used: at least 70% total CO2 capture plus recognised capture, transport and permanent-storage practice.
For Amber: Paris-aligned net-zero plan and listed decarbonisation measure implemented before 2040.
Applicable vehicle standards, exterior noise, tyres and battery-safety standards met.
Lubricants, chemicals, batteries and vehicle life-cycle waste safely handled; reuse / recycling provided.
Whole-building baseline adjusted for occupancy/weather; recognised method for floor area at least 1,000 m².
Whole-building Green requires new-building criteria; Amber improvement route is separate. Certification not required solely for Amber.
Compliant water fittings under JSMO / recognised water-efficiency standards.
No asbestos; controlled hazardous substances; contamination and indoor-air checks as applicable.
At least 40% by weight nonhazardous construction/demolition waste recovered; soil/stone excluded.
At least 70% timber recycled/reused or certified sustainably sourced; justified N/A if no timber.
Protected habitats, endangered species and forest conversion exclusions assessed.
Green: recognised qualifying certification or RSS EPC A/A+ and codes. Amber before 2030: EPC B, LEED Silver or EDGE level 2.
Eligible renewable / EV equipment and permits, or top two populated efficiency classes / recognised benchmark / evidenced BAT.
Installation must not increase fossil-fuel consumption.

decisionRules.rule: True only if the action record is valid, requestedState is Closed, closure evidence exists, verifierId exists and differs from ownerId, and openedOn <= verifiedOn <= asOf. A requested Closed state without these becomes Closure pending.
derived decisionState != Closed AND dueOn < asOf. daysOverdue = max(0, asOf - dueOn). Closed action is not currently overdue, even if it closed late.
An Applicable, entered Fail remains Fail; missing or expired evidence must not erase a known failure.

Require unique record ID and unique assessmentId+criterionId, expected criterion/family/scope, evidence, owner, independent reviewer, reviewedOn <= asOf <= expiresOn and expiresOn >= reviewedOn. Applicable + Pass then yields Pass.

N/A is complete only if applicability and enteredResult are both N/A, rationale and current independently reviewed evidence exist, and the activity/path-specific whitelist permits it. Otherwise Pending. MSS and SC-EVIDENCE cannot be waived.
decisionRules.authority: Conditional applicability control; source-specific scope retained

decisionRules.rule: Fail if any expected applicable criterion fails. Pass only if every expected criterion ID appears exactly once and resolves to Pass or valid N/A, with no unexpected records. Missing/invalid/duplicate/extra records give Pending. Enterprise MSS conflicts block all affected borrower claims.

Require a unique valid facility, finite nonnegative allocatedUSDm, and sum of all allocations for that facility <= drawnUSDm + 0.000001. Positive allocation requires evidence. Zero is No allocation. An Overallocated facility cannot contribute any approved claim.
decisionRules.authority: Allocation reconciliation policy; activity classification is distinct from finance

decisionRules.rule: Technical Fail or safeguards Fail -> Red / not aligned under Jordan, Not eligible internally. Unsupported/missing technical criteria -> Criteria required. Incomplete safeguards -> Pending. Complete supported Amber route -> Amber. Otherwise Green under Jordan or Eligible (internal).
decisionRules.authority: Taxonomy categories plus clearly separate workflow states

decisionRules.rule: Rejected approval -> Rejected. Known ineligible classification -> Not eligible. Otherwise require current independent assessment review, explicit Approved, passed safeguards, valid eligible class, no legal prohibition and no unresolved Critical E&S or Taxonomy action. Incomplete guard -> Pending; no allocation -> Activity only; valid positive allocation -> Approved.
decisionRules.authority: Internal claim approval and evidence-control policy

decisionRules.rule: Only Approved claims contribute allocatedUSDm. Green and Eligible (internal) enter their explicitly labelled selected-scheme total; Amber is always separate. Pending, rejected, ineligible and activity-only records contribute zero. Never combine duplicate financing allocations.

Country-selection scope is the selected country plus Global. Within that scope, require valid owner and distinct approver, internal target, source/authority and record keys. Non-Implemented -> Open. Implemented without current dated evidence -> Evidence required / Expired. Valid evidence -> Verified. Unknown legal applicability remains Applicability review, regardless of technical completion.
Verified in-scope controls / in-scope controls. No in-scope controls -> null / Not assessed (do not report 0% or 100% compliance). Keep legal applicability, overdue controls and coverage visible.
